8.15. iLock_Geography.geo_type¶

The module consists of two classes, GeoType for modeling a base type, and CompoundGeoType for modeling a compound type.

Classes

CompoundGeoType(name, *subTypes) A CompoundGeoType models a compound geography type that consists of several subtypes.
GeoType(name, iterableDomain) A GeoType models a base geography type.
